scope: Formatting-only candidate for accepted Beagle incoming-family-01, incoming-network-01, and misc-outgoing-01 groups. No relationship re-adjudication, accepted mutation, source rewrite, or export.
method: Used accepted primary notes/decisions and preserved source HTML. Each requirement points to a feature-bearing paragraph or explicit source-layer boundary; quotes are literal body text checked against pinned HTML hashes.

requirements.requirement: Keep this Catherine Darwin family letter as Catherine's authorial voice; its indirect reports of Charles's welfare and closing signature must not be recast as Charles prose.

evidence.quote: I do not fail to make frequent enquiries about you from your Sisters
evidence.notes: P1 reports Catherine's enquiries through the sisters; the closing is signed “C. Darwin”, but the body authority is Catherine. Preserve reported family knowledge separately from Charles voice.

requirements.requirement: Render the multipart Charlotte Wewd continuation as separate dated authorial sections, preserving the engagement news and prospective voyage knowledge.

evidence.quote: Jan 29th My letter has been lying by a little more than a fortnight
evidence.notes: P2 is a later continuation of the earlier wedding-family letter; date markers are body chronology, not one composition date.

requirements.requirement: Keep Darwin's April 5 receipt of the Caroline and family letters distinct from his April 3 travel section and from the quoted family correspondence.

evidence.quote: I this morning received your letter of Decr 31 & Catherines of Feb 4th.
evidence.notes: P5 explicitly identifies received letters and their dates; this is Darwin receipt evidence and should not be attributed to Caroline or collapsed into the header date.

requirements.requirement: Preserve Fanny Owen's personal announcement and the separate March 1 family postscript, while recording that Darwin explicitly acknowledges this Fanny letter in DCP-LETT-169.

evidence.quote: My fate is indeed decided, the die is cast
evidence.notes: P2 is Fanny's first-person engagement announcement; P5 separately labels March 1 and carries Mama/Caroline greetings. Keep the mixed family voices and dated layers.

requirements.requirement: Render the San Lambert memorandum, CD extract, and CD note as distinct layers; the extract is not a single incoming authorial letter.

evidence.quote: [The paragraphs above are Charles San Lambert’s memorandum. The paragraph below is CD’s extract (DAR 37: 648)
evidence.notes: The source explicitly marks the transition from San Lambert's memorandum to Darwin's extract/note. Preserve provenance and do not merge the voices or export the extract as Lambert's full body.

requirements.requirement: Preserve the map as an image with its grey annotations and distinguish the R. E. Alison prose from the visual/map layer.

evidence.quote: I have merely scratched this croquis7 out by the rule of thumb
evidence.notes: P5 calls the sketch a croquis and describes dotted roads; the grey annotations belong to the SVG/image layer and must not be invented as body prose.

requirements.requirement: Render the Beagle-era Valparaiso sea-wall evidence with its diagram/measurement visual separately from the witness prose.

evidence.quote: A Mr John Martin4 a ship Carpenter of respectability in this place mentions that in 1819 he has walked at the foot of the sea wall on the beach
evidence.notes: P2 is Alison reporting John Martin's recollection; the visual has its own evidence layer (11 ft 6 in and 8 ft). Do not turn the reported witness or diagram labels into Darwin voice.

requirements.requirement: Preserve the complete tabular list of Chilean elevations, including row units and labels, rather than treating the heading as a prose summary.

evidence.quote: Height of various places in Chile ascertained by Barometrical Admeasurement.
evidence.notes: The following rows are a structured feet table; retain row order, labels, and the unit heading as table data.

requirements.requirement: Keep this long earthquake report as a multi-section observational record: verbal reports, the author's own notes, and omitted queries are different extents and voices.

evidence.quote: my information was verbal accuired on the spot where the observations were taken
evidence.notes: P2 identifies information gathered verbally; later paragraphs switch to first-person notebook observations and P19 says geology/Astronomy/Hydraulics queries were omitted. Preserve the missing-input boundary and do not flatten the report.

requirements.requirement: Render Corfield's multipart June 27 letter with its enclosure/financial accounting and later dated continuation as one source with separate sections.

evidence.quote: It gave me infinite pleasure to receive your much wished for letter, which was brought by the Beagle.
evidence.notes: P3 acknowledges Darwin's letter arriving by the Beagle; P4 encloses a clothes account and P7 begins the Saturday June 27 continuation. Receipt, accounting enclosure, and later news must remain scoped.

requirements.requirement: Preserve Corfield's multipart July 18 continuation and distinguish local business/news from his earlier June composition and prospective correspondence.

evidence.quote: Since writing the foregoing several more vessels have arrived from Lpool
evidence.notes: P6 is explicitly a continuation dated July 18; the shipping/news paragraph and enclosed newspaper are not evidence that Darwin had received the later material.

source_pins.role: cross-reference for explicit acknowledgement of DCP-LETT-162

recommendations: Keep third-party, memorandum, map, table, and family voices as separate source layers.
Treat receipt, prospective delivery, and body-date continuation as distinct chronology fields.
Apply cleanup only where the requirement is marked planned_repair; retain unresolved visual or transcription questions as holds.
